title: Smooth-Look
description: Visual Overhaul Modpack with good Performance and Visuals
body:
# Smooth-Look
Is a Vanila+ Styled Modpack with Perfomance, Ambients & Terrain Mods

While having a lot of Ambient & Terrain Mods, it still offers Great perfomance

The Terrain Mods are:

Tectonic,
WWOO,
and much more!

One other core mod is: Friends&Foes which adds The Outvoted Mobs from the Mob Votes.

The Modpack is natively compatible with Distant Horizons & Voxy, just add it to the pack and be ready to go!

If you have any problems or Questions, just ask on my little Discord Server.
